title: Hardship Cushion on Credit-Card Payments, Placed Consumer Accounts
content:
Cashiering standard clause for **Placed Consumer Accounts** on the hardship cushion held back from the credit-card ceiling of the day after a recent hardship hold, read from the account's Hardship and Protective Holds records.

## Clause

The credit-card ceiling's hardship cushion is:
- **$150.00** where a Documented Hardship Hold on the account ended in the last 6 months;
- **$75.00** where no Documented Hardship Hold on the account ended in the last 6 months but a 30-Day Hardship Pause on the account did;
- **nothing** where no hardship hold of either tier on the account ended in the last 6 months.

The cushion is subtracted, at its full amount, in working out the credit-card ceiling.

## Reading the clause

- The records read are the Hardship and Protective Holds records of the placed account: each hold's tier and its ended date (the last day the hold covered, or the withdrawal date). A hold that has not ended has no ended date and does not count.
- Only the two tiers named count: the Documented Hardship Hold and the 30-Day Hardship Pause. Holds of the other tiers are not read here.
- A hold ended in the last 6 months when fewer than six whole calendar months separate its ended date from the handling date, a whole month being reached on the same day of a later month. On a handling date of 2026-10-10 an ended date of 2026-04-11 is inside that period and 2026-04-10 is not.
- A Documented Hardship Hold that ended in the period settles the cushion at $150.00 whatever the 30-Day Hardship Pause records show.

## Condition table

| Documented Hardship Hold ended in the last 6 months | 30-Day Hardship Pause ended in the last 6 months | Cushion |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | $150.00 |
| Yes | No | $150.00 |
| No | Yes | $75.00 |
| No | No | nothing |

## Hypothetical cases

*Invented hold histories, handling date 2026-10-10.*

- A Documented Hardship Hold ended on 2026-03-15 and a 30-Day Hardship Pause ended on 2026-08-02. The Documented Hardship Hold ended more than six whole months ago, the pause within them: cushion $75.00.
- A Disaster Relief Hold ended on 2026-09-01 and no other hold ever ran. Neither named tier ended in the period: cushion nothing.
- A 30-Day Hardship Pause is still active on the handling date. It has no ended date: cushion nothing, unless a Documented Hardship Hold ended in the period.
